record.issue_text: packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:254 — When a booking reference has no `externalCalendarId`, the fallback searches for a calendar whose ID equals the same null value and passes `undefined` to Google instead of updating the destination or primary calendar.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 253-254 in the diff for GoogleCalendarService.ts updateEvent method: `const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (null/undefined), the code falls back to searching destinationCalendar for a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (which is null/undefined). This will never find a match since no calendar would have externalId equal to null/undefined, so it returns undefined. This is clearly a logic bug - the fallback condition makes no sense as it's comparing against the same null value. The same bug pattern appears in deleteEvent at line 314-315.
